description: This file defines an interface for a transaction test grain in Orleans, including methods for setting, adding, retrieving, and throwing exceptions related to transaction states.

classes.name: ITransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transaction test grain with methods to manipulate transaction states and simulate errors.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the transaction state to a new value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and returns the updated state.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and throws an exception.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Sets the transaction state to a value and throws an exception.
